Dorte Damgaard is a medical professional specializing in cardiovascular health, serving as a chief physician (overlæge) and holding a PhD at Aarhus University Hospital (Aarhus Universitetshospital) [^src1]. She is actively involved in national clinical quality development in Denmark as a member of the steering group for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) [^src1]. 

Her role on the steering group is documented in the AFDK annual report covering the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, which was published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. The steering group is responsible for overseeing the database's data foundation, validity, and descriptive reporting, which ultimately serves as the basis for political and clinical decision-making regarding atrial fibrillation in Denmark [^src1].
